questions: Panels to the UCON survey: walls A / D {{@s['walls'][1]['L']}}, walls B / C {{@s['walls'][0]['L']}}, height {{@s['walls'][1]['ceil'][0][2]}}; joints 10; free spans split equally. Sizes per A-701 replace your REV 3 (order 260336). Numbers: P01-P07 = your elevation 1 (1-7), P08-P19 = elevation 2 (1-12), P20-P26 = elevation 3 (1-7), P27-P38 = elevation 4 (1-12). Your drawing: walls 2 / 4 1204 / 4 x 1244 / 1204, lower 2755, upper 309. Please confirm.

Inside corners as our Main Kitchen: walls A / D run through, panels {{pn('P14')['s0']}} short of walls B / C; walls B / C stand between the A / D panel faces with a 10 joint. Your REV 3 stops all panels 45 short of every corner and covers it with an 'edge covering' (OPT. 1 / OPT. 2) - we do not use it. Please confirm.

Heights as our Main Kitchen: the panels sit on the stone plinth (by others) - top {{stone}} above the subfloor = {{stone - ffl}} above the finished floor - and stop 10 under the ceiling ({{@s['walls'][1]['ceil'][0][2] - 10}}). One horizontal joint {{seam('Wall A')}} / {{upper('Wall A')}} all round the room: lower panels {{h('P14')}} high as your REV 3 (the wide panels no taller than you drew them), upper {{h('P08')}}; the piers of window B / opening C cut at the same joint, the bands over them from {{z0('P02')}} / {{z0('P22')}}. Your REV 3: panels 10 above a 210 stone, up to the ceiling (upper 309). Please confirm.

Joints: 10 open, as all our AP rooms. Your REV 3 note: 'between all panels brass colour wood in glossy finish'. We draw open joints - please confirm whether the brass strip is wanted; if yes, its section, finish and fixing (the clips must stay reachable).

Window (wall B), as our Main Kitchen windows: MDF {{ln('B-WIN')['t']}} L-liner, leg on the 2nd step of the window trim ({{ln('B-WIN')['leg'][0]}} into the opening, {{ln('B-WIN')['depth']}} deep), flange {{ln('B-WIN')['flange'] + ln('B-WIN')['leg'][0]}} behind the panel into a slot of two MDF 6 strips glued to the panel back - B 6 x 34 + A 6 x 17, as our Main Kitchen v1.0 (CHANGED in v2.0: please glue the strips per the D-sheets), corners mitred 45; sides and head only - the window runs to the floor, the legs stop on the stone. Panels {{pn('P06')['s1'] - op('B-WIN')['s0']}} over the opening edge. Can you make the liners? Please comment or propose your detail.

Opening (wall C), as our ML Foyer openings: MDF {{ln('C-OPN')['t']}} L-liner against the bare reveal, {{ln('C-OPN')['depth']}} past the wall face, flange {{ln('C-OPN')['flange']}} behind the panel into the slot of strips B 6 x 34 + A 6 x 17 glued to the panel back by the factory (CHANGED in v2.0, D-sheets), corners mitred 45; pier panels {{op('C-OPN')['s0'] - pn('P25')['s1']}} short of the jamb line, band {{z0('P22') - oh('C-OPN')}} above the head. Please confirm.
Your REV 3 note at the opening returns: '4X 26 mm white matt finish wood to cover clips and gap' - replaced by the liners of Q5 / Q6. Please confirm.

Panels hang on Fastmount VL-03H clips, recess mount, gap {{bu['clip_gap']}}. Please make the clip recesses in the panel backs at the factory per the D-sheets (D{{@s['clips']['hole_d']}} x {{@s['clips']['panel_depth']}} deep). Please confirm which clip half goes into the panel (we assume male).

All drilling coordinates are given from the panel BACK: X from the left edge as seen from the back, Z from the bottom edge. A control column gives X from the face. Please confirm before drilling - mirrored drilling is the main risk.
Window trim profile measured at the left jamb (seen from the room) and modelled on both jambs and the head (Andriy 2026-10-19). To be checked on site before the liners are cut.

Liner fixing (NEW in v2.0): we draw strips B 6 x 34 + A 6 x 17 glued to the panel backs at the window / opening edges, the liner flange in the slot between them (as our Main Kitchen v1.0). Alternative under study: separate liner pieces fixed on site by UCON instead of the strips. Please comment which you prefer, or propose your detail.
sheets.questions_note: Red number = open question, marked with the same red bubble on the sheet it belongs to. Answers to be written in the ANSWER column and returned; the drawings are reissued after the answers.

G-001: Survey by UCON. All dimensions in mm, Z from the top of the subfloor. Dimensions per UCON survey govern; from the TM drawings (order 260336, 252234 REV 3) only the panel numbering is used.

Wall panels MDF {{bu['panel_t']}}, finish per TM; joints 10 open (Q4); on the stone plinth (by others), 10 under the ceiling; inside corners as Main Kitchen - walls A / D through, B / C between them (Q2). Panel face {{bu['face']}} from the wall = backing frame {{bu['frame_t']}} + clip gap {{bu['clip_gap']}} + panel {{bu['panel_t']}}. Numbers P01..P38 = TM elevations 1-4 (Q1).

Backing frames S01..S{{format('%02d', @s['frames'].values.sum { |f| f['frames'].size })}}: plywood 3/4", made, drilled and fixed by UCON (A-20x, A-702, A-703), from the stone top {{@s['levels']['floor_gap']}}; a frame member, a liner flange or a joint block MDF 6 (UCON) behind every panel joint - no raw wall in a joint. Clips Fastmount VL-03H, recess mount, {{@s['holes'].size}} pcs: panel recesses by the factory per the D-sheets (BACK VIEW), frame holes by UCON CNC.

Window (wall B) and opening (wall C): MDF 6 L-liners as Main Kitchen / ML Foyer; v2.0: the flange in a slot of strips B / A glued to the panel back by the factory, as Main Kitchen v1.0 (A-511, A-512, D-sheets, Q5 - Q7).
Red marks are open questions or TBD items. Not for production until G-002 is answered and the set is reissued.

A-1: Walls, openings and heights per UCON site survey - they govern over the factory drawings. Window B {{ow('B-WIN')}} x {{oh('B-WIN')}}, opening C {{ow('C-OPN')}} x {{oh('C-OPN')}}, both to the floor; ceiling {{@s['walls'][1]['ceil'][0][2]}}.
A-2:*: Frames from the stone top {{@s['levels']['floor_gap']}} to the ceiling; tier joint {{@s['levels']['tier_joint']}}; band over the window / opening from the head + frame setback; a frame member behind every panel joint. Built and fixed by UCON.
A-3:*: Panels MDF {{bu['panel_t']}}, finish per TM; joints 10; on the stone top {{stone}}, 10 under the ceiling. Horizontal joint {{seam('{w}')}} / {{upper('{w}')}}. Numbers = TM elevations 1-4 (Q1).
A-701: Panels P01..P38, numbers = TM 252234 REV 3 elevations 1-4 (Q1).
